summary: The marks this kit ships as the default reading of `a document owes something` (ADR-019 decision 5). Four rows, each calibrated, and deliberately few: a mark earns its place by being unambiguous in prose, not by being common. A host that writes obligations another way declares its own set against this same schema and the two are read together -- neither file edits the other. Modal verbs are NOT here on purpose: a document full of MUST is a law doing its job, and a marker that fires on every law would make the reachability reading a count of doctrine rather than a count of debts.

markers.because: an unticked task box is the one mark whose meaning is settled by its own form: somebody wrote the box, and the box is not ticked. Its closed form is one character away, so the state is unambiguous in both directions.
markers.proves: - [ ] declare the budget row before the ratchet turns on
markers.admits: - [x] declare the budget row before the ratchet turns on

markers.because: the universal mark for work left behind in a document. It is followed by a colon or a space where it is meant as a marker, and by other letters where it is being discussed.
markers.proves: TODO: route this document from an entry before the ratchet is measured
markers.admits: the TODOs of the 2025 audit were all closed when the card closed

markers.because: a TODO that also asserts something is currently WRONG, which makes it an obligation with a defect attached. Kept as its own row rather than folded into the one above, because the two are counted differently by whoever triages them.
markers.proves: FIXME: this authority is read from the filename, which the ADR forbids
markers.admits: a FIXME, written as prose inside a sentence, is not a marker

markers.because: a field left blank on purpose is an open decision with an owner, which is precisely an obligation the control plane must be able to reach. Terminated by punctuation or a space where it is a placeholder; followed by letters where it is being talked about.
markers.proves: owner: TBD, to be settled at the next review
markers.admits: the TBDs in that table were filled in before it was accepted
